sentence: This project studies which parts of the gene regulatory network make an Antarctic sea urchin develop slowly.
This project builds artificial intelligence tools that find hidden patterns in ultrafast X-ray scattering data to understand how matter behaves.
This project designs a learning course about nanofabrication that mixes virtual instruction with hands-on work in university research labs.
This project designs a research facility where insects can be raised in large numbers to study how insect production works at industrial scale.
This project builds computer models that use artificial intelligence to simulate electromagnetic fields in tiny optical channels on computer chips.
This project builds laser-based tools to watch how molecules of different sizes and charges move through a tiny valve made from a protein toxin.
This project uses random matrix theory to study how deep neural networks learn and how to speed up their learning.
This project studies how chemical modifications change the structure and folding of transfer RNA molecules.
This project tests a fusion protein that crosses the blood-brain barrier to repair damaged mitochondrial DNA in neurons after traumatic brain injury.
This project tests how individual brain cells in the human medial temporal lobe turn visual experiences into lasting memories.
This project holds a conference on celestial mechanics and mathematical billiards, two areas that study trajectories shaped by geometry.
This project studies how living together with algal symbionts changes how much energy a coral puts into growth and reproduction.
This project builds 3D photonic surfaces inspired by nature that turn the light response of fibrous tissue into color to show its structure.
This project builds a computer vision system that finds object types it does not yet know and keeps updating itself with little human annotation.
This project builds portable devices that test environmental samples to detect emerging pathogens early.
This project tests how warming and interactions with microbes, plants and other insects change how abundant aphids are, using field experiments.
This project holds a workshop on how to manufacture quantum integrated photonics systems in silicon foundries.
This project tests physical models of the human nasal airway to see where an aerosol drug deposits inside the nose.
